# Diablo 2 Vertical Slice — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Execute inline with superpowers:executing-plans. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A fully playable isometric action-RPG in the browser, with every sprite, tile, icon and sound generated by code at load time.

**Architecture:** Fixed 60 Hz simulation in tile space, isometric painter's-algorithm renderer with a multiply-composited light buffer. Sprites bake once at startup into per-entity sprite sheets. Six seeded procedural areas. One-way module dependencies: `core` → `art`/`audio` → `items` → `world`/`game` → `render`/`ui` → `main`.

**Tech Stack:** Plain ES modules, Canvas 2D, Web Audio. No dependencies, no bundler, no framework.

## Global Constraints

- No image, audio or font files. Anything visual or audible is computed at runtime.
- No npm dependencies, runtime or dev. `build.js` uses only Node builtins.
- ES modules with explicit `.js` extensions in every import.
- Tile is 64x32. `screen_x = (wx-wy)*32`, `screen_y = (wx+wy)*16`.
- Simulation step is exactly `1/60` s, max 5 catch-up steps per frame.
- Sprite cell is 80x80, 8 directions (0–4 generated, 5–7 mirrored), sheets 8 columns wide.
- Level cap 30. Player resistances cap at 75.
- No emoji anywhere in code, comments, UI text or commit messages.
- Verification is browser-driven. A phase is not done until its listed check has been observed in a real browser with a clean console.

### Task 1: Shell, loop, isometric camera

**Files:**
- Create: `index.html`, `src/main.js`, `src/core/loop.js`, `src/core/iso.js`, `src/core/rng.js`, `src/core/input.js`

**Interfaces produced:**
- `rng.js` — `mulberry32(seed) -> ()=>float`, `Rng` class with `.f()`, `.i(n)`, `.range(a,b)`, `.pick(arr)`, `.chance(p)`, `.fork(salt)`; `valueNoise2(rng)` returns `(x,y)=>float` in 0..1
- `iso.js` — `TILE_W=64`, `TILE_H=32`, `worldToScreen(wx,wy) -> {x,y}`, `screenToWorld(sx,sy) -> {x,y}`, `Camera{x,y,w,h, follow(t,dt), toScreen(wx,wy), toWorld(px,py), visibleTileBounds()}`, `dirFromVector(dx,dy) -> 0..7`
- `loop.js` — `startLoop({step, draw})` running fixed 1/60 accumulator, `TICK=1/60`
- `input.js` — `Input` singleton: `.mouse{x,y,downL,downR,pressedL,pressedR}`, `.keys`, `.pressed(code)`, `.consume(code)`, `.shift`, `.alt`, `endFrame()`

**Steps:**
- [ ] Write `index.html`: full-viewport canvas, dark background, module script tag, no inline styles beyond a reset
- [ ] Write `src/core/rng.js` with mulberry32 and value noise
- [ ] Write `src/core/iso.js` with the projection pair, camera, and 8-direction helper
- [ ] Write `src/core/loop.js` fixed-timestep accumulator
- [ ] Write `src/core/input.js`, suppressing the context menu so right-click is usable
- [ ] Write a throwaway `src/main.js` that draws an iso grid of diamonds and moves the camera with the mouse
- [ ] **Browser check:** grid renders, is correctly diamond-shaped, camera follows, console clean

### Task 2: Pixel rasterizer and palettes

**Files:**
- Create: `src/art/palette.js`, `src/art/pixel.js`

**Interfaces produced:**
- `palette.js` — `hexToRgb(h)`, `rgbToHex`, `shift(hex, dL, dS)`, `ramp(hex) -> {light,base,dark,line}` (four packed 0xAABBGGRR ints), `PALETTES` map of named palettes
- `pixel.js` — `Buf(w,h)` wrapping `Uint32Array`; `px(buf,x,y,c)`, `capsule(buf,x0,y0,r0,x1,y1,r1,ramp,lightDir)`, `ellipse(buf,cx,cy,rx,ry,ramp)`, `rectF`, `lineP`, `polyF`, `outline(buf,color)`, `bufToCanvas(buf)`, `blitBuf(dst,src,dx,dy)`

**Notes:** All colour is packed little-endian `0xAABBGGRR` so it writes straight into `ImageData`'s `Uint32Array` view. Shading picks a ramp entry from the dot product of the pixel's offset against the light direction, default up-left.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Write `palette.js` with HSL-based ramp derivation
- [ ] Write `pixel.js` rasterizers, `outline` last-pass border
- [ ] Temporarily render a test row of capsules and ellipses in `main.js`
- [ ] **Browser check:** shapes are crisp with no antialiasing fringe, shading reads as a single upper-left light, outlines are exactly one pixel
- [ ] Commit

### Task 3: Figure poser and sprite sheets

**Files:**
- Create: `src/art/figures.js`

**Interfaces produced:**
- `FIGURE_SPECS` — keyed specs: `{palette, height, build, weapon, anims}` for `sorceress`, `fallen`, `devilkin`, `shaman`, `zombie`, `ghoul`, `quillrat`, `skeleton`, `corpsefire`, `bloodraven`, `andariel`
- `bakeFigure(spec) -> {canvas, cell, index(anim,dir,frame) -> {sx,sy,flip}}`
- `ANIMS = {idle:4, walk:8, attack:6, cast:6, death:8}`
- `bakeAllFigures(onProgress) -> generator` yielding after each animation so baking can be chunked across frames

**Notes:** Joints computed in a right-handed 3D frame (x right, y depth, z up) then projected with the iso transform. Limbs drawn back-to-front by depth. Attack lands on frame 3; death's final frame is the persistent corpse.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Write the skeleton model and per-animation joint curves
- [ ] Write the projection and back-to-front limb draw
- [ ] Write sheet packing (8 columns) and the frame index function
- [ ] Write all eleven figure specs
- [ ] Render a walk cycle of every figure in all 8 directions in `main.js`
- [ ] **Browser check:** every figure is recognisable, walks convincingly, all 8 directions face correctly, mirrored directions are not visibly wrong-handed
- [ ] Commit

## Self-Review

**Spec coverage:** Sections 2–3 in Task 1; 4.1–4.2 in Task 2; 4.3 in Task 3; 4.4 and particles in Task 4; 4.5 in Task 8; 5 in Task 6; 6 in Task 5; 7 in Task 7; 8 in Task 10; 9 in Tasks 8 and 11; 10 in Task 12; 11 and 13 in Task 13; 12 across all; 14 in Task 13; constraint on single-file packaging in Task 14. No section unaccounted for.

**Placeholders:** none. Every task names exact files and the exact interfaces it publishes.

**Type consistency:** `Level`, `Rng`, `Camera`, `Item`, `Player`, `Monster`, `Projectiles`, `Particles` are each defined in exactly one task and consumed by name thereafter. `bakeFigure`/`bakeTiles`/`bakeIcons` share the same `onProgress` generator protocol so Task 4's loading screen drives all three.
